text.en:
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S 81

MEDICINES ORDER, 2007 NOTIFICATION OF COMMENCEMENT UNDER SECTION 1(2)/a) In exercise of the power conferred by section 1(2)(a) of the Medicines Order, 2007, the Minister of Health, with approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints the 1st. January, 2008 as the commencement date for cosmetic products. Dated this 21st. day of Zulhijjah, 1428 Hijriah corresponding to the 31st. day of December, 2007.

PERIN ORANG KAYA INDERA PAHLAWAN DATO SERI SETIA

AWANG HAJI SUYOI BIN HAJI OSMAN Minister of Health, Brunei Darussalam.
